title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Carried-In Credit: Reserve Days Added for Late Payment Charges
content:
The reserve days kept back when a standard-billing credit balance is carried into PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) are increased according to the late payment charges billed on the enrolled service account in its Electric Service by Rate Schedule records during the twelve-month window.

| Late payment charges billed on the enrolled service account in the twelve-month window | Reserve days |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | increased by 6 |
| at least 1 but fewer than 3 | increased by 3 |
| none | not increased for late charges |

**Clause.** Where at least 3 late payment charges were billed on the enrolled service account in the twelve-month window, the reserve days are increased by 6; where at least one but fewer than 3 were, the reserve days are increased by 3; with none the reserve days are not increased for late charges.

**Window.** The twelve-month window takes the late payment charges dated after the same day of the month twelve months before the current date, through the current date.

**Notes (hypothetical counts).**
- 2 late payment charges in the window: increased by 3. A third one in the window: increased by 6.
- 1 late payment charge dated thirteen months ago and none since: outside the window, so not increased for late charges.
- No late payment charge in the window: the reserve days are not increased for late charges.
